meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在编辑代码后会自动检查新增或修改的注释。如果发现注释有问题，会收到阻止性反馈，需要先修复或解释该注释才能继续。
howto.when: 当 Claude 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit、multi_edit 或 multiedit 等编辑操作后，自动触发注释检查。

say.text: 检查我刚改的代码里的注释有没有问题。
say.note: 触发对最近一次编辑的注释检查。

say.text: 解释一下为什么这个注释被标记为警告。
say.note: 要求 Claude 说明注释检查器的反馈原因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically checks new or modified comments after editing code. If a comment issue is found, it receives blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically after successful edit operations such as apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit.

say_en.text: Check the comments in the code I just edited for issues.
say_en.note: Triggers comment check on the latest edit.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was flagged as a warning.
say_en.note: Asks Claude to explain the comment checker's feedback.
